Protect your money

5 red flags
in finance
content 🚩

Spot them before you trust a video.

01

"Guaranteed returns"

No real investment can promise a return. Higher possible returns always come with higher risk.

02

"Buy this now, before it's too late"

Urgency plus telling you exactly what to buy. Good education explains how things work; it doesn't push you.

03

Hidden sponsorship

Paid, gifted or on commission? EU guidance says it must be disclosed openly, not hidden in a hashtag.

04

High-risk products, zero risk talk

CFDs, forex, futures and volatile crypto can lose you 100% of what you put in. If that's not said, be careful.

05

Opinions dressed up as facts

Facts should come with a source. Opinions should be labeled as opinions.
